note: Which tables hold eMithran reference data (rates, lookups, process and material knowledge: eMithran intellectual property). Built from `npm run migrations:inventory` (step 4 of the on-premises plan). From migration `noNewRowsAfter` on, migrations may change these tables' schema but must not write their rows: reference data ships in versioned, licensed data packages (step 5). `shared` tables hold eMithran rows AND customer rows with no reliable marker of which is which; they need a provenance column before they can be packaged. Checked by src/common/migrations/reference-data.spec.ts.

shared.public.calculators: global calculators have user_id IS NULL; customers' own have a user_id or organization_id
shared.public.costing_settings: eMithran defaults and per-environment overrides in one table
shared.public.mhr_records: global rows are marked three different ways (is_global, user_id IS NULL, organization_id IS NULL), inconsistently
shared.public.raw_materials: user_id is NOT NULL, so seeded rows are owned by whichever account ran the seed

exceptions.978_plastic_material_cut_codes.sql: Writes the cut code of 109 plastic materials onto raw_materials (generated from memory/plastic modeling/materials_final.csv, only where the row has none). The operations that decide from the material's cut code (passivation, magnetic particle testing, carburizing, carbonitriding) stop at 'cut code needed' without it. Remove this entry when raw_materials has a provenance column and the cut codes ship in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.984_restore_secondary_op_catalog_rows_lo: Puts back five process_calculator_mappings rows and their four process_taxonomy rows (counterboring, countersinking, PEM insertion, and tapping on milled and turned parts) that migration 702 restored and migration 731 then deleted by a machine-class keep-list that did not name drill_press, pem_press or tapping. The rows are copied from 731's own backup tables and bind calculators that were never deleted; without them every counterbore, countersink and PEM insert is unresolved and a route holding one cannot be applied. Remove this entry when process_calculator_mappings and process_taxonomy ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.981_black_oxide_wage_grade_labor_rate.sq: Gives each Black Oxide machine row in mhr_records the labor rate of its wage grade ('2 - Metal', memory/SurfaceTreatment/surface_treatment_wage_grades.csv), where the other machines of the grade agree on one value and the row has none; those rows have no labor rate and the engine drops a machine without one. It writes inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when the rate ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1025_plastic_secondary_op_catalog_rows.s: Adds, under Plastic Molding, the process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings rows of the material drying, visual inspection and weight check machine classes (bound by name to the calculators of migrations 1023 and 1024). Without them Apply cannot place those lines (no process group) and refuses the whole route. Remove this entry when process_calculator_mappings and process_taxonomy ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1026_complete_tapping_table_from_reaming: Adds the tblTapping rows of the 72 material cut codes the source screenshot cut off (aluminum, stainless, copper, titanium, plastics), derived from the staged tblReaming by the rule the 18 present codes follow exactly; without them every thread in those materials is unpriced and its route cannot be applied. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the complete tblTapping in it.
exceptions.1033_simultaneous_turning_route_role.sql: Gives the Simultaneous Turning row of process_taxonomy the route role its sibling lathes have ('primary_turning', migration 780), where it has none; without it the multi-spindle lathes are never offered as a route although their machines are rated and their turning engine is registered. Remove this entry when process_taxonomy ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the role in it.
exceptions.1034_router_route_role.sql: Gives the 3 Axis Router and 5 Axis Router rows of process_taxonomy a route role ('primary_routing', added to the column's allowed values), where they have none; without it the routers are never listed in the route comparison although their machines are rated. Remove this entry when process_taxonomy ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the role in it.
exceptions.1036_milling_removal_rate_table.sql: Stages the milling material removal rates (one per material class, the eMithran baseline) as the lookup table tblMillingRemovalRate in machining_reference_data; they were a table in the cost engine's source, and every milling calculator needs the rate as an input. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the table in it.
exceptions.1039_milling_finishing_table.sql: Stages the finishing end mill cutting speed and feed per material class (the eMithran baseline, from a published carbide end mill chart) as the lookup table tblMillingFinishing in machining_reference_data; the finishing calculators time a tool path at this feed, and memory/Machining has only a partial milling table with no aluminium. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the table in it.
exceptions.1040_machining_min_wall_table.sql: Stages the recommended and feasible minimum wall thickness of a machined part per material class (the eMithran baseline, from published CNC design guides) as the lookup table tblMachiningMinWall in machining_reference_data; the design-for-machining check grades the measured wall against it, and memory/Machining has no wall-thickness limit. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the table in it.
exceptions.1042_gtol_roll_forming_mid_punch_best.sq: Corrects one transcription slip in the staged tblGtolProcessCapabilities of machining_reference_data: the Best Achievable of Sheet Metal Roll Forming Mid Punch (diamTolerance and tolerance) reads 0.782 mm where every other copy of the table gives 0.762 mm; an already staged table can only be corrected in place. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the corrected value in it.
exceptions.1043_turning_live_tooling.sql: Adds mhr_records.live_tooling_power_kw and fills it, per machine, from each turning machine's own memory/Machining/machine row (machiningusa.csv, millturn_usa.csv, simultaneous_turning_usa.csv, stock_prep_lathe_usa.csv). Without it a lathe with no live-tool spindle is priced for cross and off-axis holes it cannot drill (R_M-0230-032 was applied to a 2-axis lathe). Only the new column of existing machine rows is written; no row is added. Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the column in it.
exceptions.1044_die_casting_india_supporting_machin: Adds the India rows of the 154 Die Casting machines beside the press (melting, trim, cleaning, finishing, coremaking, core coating and drying, visual inspection) to mhr_records: each USA row cloned at its India direct and indirect overhead rate (memory/Countries data/India_XML_Data_.csv, commodity Casting - Die) and the India labor rate of its wage grade. India had only the casting machines themselves (migration 845), so every other step of an India die-cast part was uncosted for want of a machine. It writes inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1045_investment_wax_pattern_cooling_vari: Stages two variables of the investment casting reference in machining_reference_data (source version 2026-CastInvest): the pattern wax thermal conductivity and the wax die temperature, the eMithran baseline from published studies. memory/Casting Investment has neither, and without them the wax pattern cooling time, and so the Wax Pattern Molding line of every investment casting, cannot be derived. Remove this entry when the investment casting reference ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the two variables in it.
exceptions.1047_casting_investment_india_drying_coo: Adds the India rows of the two Casting Investment work centres migrations 870 and 876 left out (Drying and Cooling, Default Machine) to mhr_records: each USA row cloned at its India overhead rate (memory/Countries data/India_XML_Data_.csv, commodity Casting - Investment). Without them the Drying and Cooling steps of an India investment casting have no machine and its route is incomplete. It writes inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1048_conveyor_conversion_coating_machine: Adds the 16 Conveyor Conversion Coating machines (pretreatment washers) to mhr_records for the USA, from the country exports (memory/Countries data, commodity Surface Treatment): memory/SurfaceTreatment/Machine has no file for the process, so migration 820 seeded none and Conveyor Conversion Coating was not costed on any part. The rows carry no hour rate (the exports hold none for the USA): the HR Rates engine prices them from their price, rated power and the USA electricity price. Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1049_forging_india_machines.sql: Adds the India rows of the 202 forging machines migration 824 seeded for the USA only to mhr_records: each USA row cloned at its India overhead rate (memory/Countries data/India_XML_Data_.csv, commodity Forging) and the India labour rate of its wage grade. Without them a forging priced in India has no machine on any step. It writes inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1050_forging_published_tables.sql: Stages two published tables the forging calculators read as lookup tables in machining_reference_data beside the forging reference data: the flash mass per length of parting line by forging mass (National Association of Drop Forgings) and the ram speed range of forging machines (Altan; Kalpakjian). memory/Forging has neither: its flash figure is by a complexity score it does not define, and its press records carry no ram speed. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the tables in it.
exceptions.1052_forging_press_force_variables.sql: Stages four variables of the forging reference in machining_reference_data (source version 2026-Forging): the forging strain rate and the pressure-multiplying factors of the forging force for a part without flash, with flash, and complex (the eMithran baseline, from the published forging force rule). memory/Forging gives each material's hot flow law and the flash land but neither, so no press could be chosen for a forged part. Remove this entry when the forging reference ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the four variables in it.
exceptions.1054_forging_routes_calculators.sql: Writes the calculators of the forging routes beside the closed-die screw press (furnace heating, die hammer, mechanical press, open die press, ring rolling) and links each to its Forging catalog operation in process_calculator_mappings. Generated from the forging calculator spec; it writes inside DO blocks, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when the calculators ship in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1055_forging_hammer_and_open_die_data.sq: Stages the forging hammer strain rate (a variable of the forging reference, the eMithran baseline) and sets each open die press's rated force (press_force_kn) in mhr_records specs, read from the machine names, as the machine file gives no force column. Without them no hammer and no open die press can be checked against the work the part needs, so neither route could be costed. Remove this entry when the forging reference and mhr_records ship in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1056_forging_open_die_press_ratings.sql: Sets the rated force (press_force_kn) in mhr_records specs of the two open die presses migration 1055 missed (Open Die Press 3000 Ton and 5000 Ton), read from their names as 1055 reads the others. Without it neither press is ever offered for an upset. Remove this entry when mhr_records ship in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1058_activate_linked_calculator_mappings: Sets is_active on the process_calculator_mappings rows the sand casting, investment casting, heat treatment and forging calculator migrations linked to a calculator but left inactive. The Process dialog and the process catalog read only active rows, so those calculators could not be opened or selected. Remove this entry when process_calculator_mappings ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1059_retire_superseded_forging_calculato: Retires (sets retired_at on) the seven forging helper calculators of migration 1051 that the adopted forging engine does not run and no catalog operation maps to; the engine runs the calculators of migrations 1053, 1054 and 1057. It writes calculators inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. exceptions.1061_india_twin_machine_labour.sql: Sets usd_lhr_total of the India forging, die casting and investment casting machine rows to their own usd_labor_rate_per_hr: the India twin migrations (1044, 1047, 1049) copied the USA labour into that column, so the machine selector charged a USA operator on India machines. Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1064_composites_catalog_machine_class.sq: Sets machine_class on the Composites process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings rows (migration 790) where it is NULL, from the classes migration 796 seeded, as migration 872 did for Casting Investment: a catalog row with no machine class cannot be active, so the composites calculators of migration 1065 could not be opened. Remove this entry when process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1067_two_model_machining_process_group.s: Renames the process group '2 Mold Molding' (named from the memory folder by migration 862) to '2-Model Machining', the name the factory tree and the cost engine use, in process_taxonomy, process_calculator_mappings and the items' scenario overrides, drops the leftover 'General' placeholder of that name, and gives it the Machining material groups in process_material_groups. exceptions.1070_additive_machines_india_and_cleanin: Adds the Additive Manufacturing machines at India rates (USA twins of migration 793 with the India export's overhead rates and the India labour of wage grade 2 - Casting, also in usd_lhr_total) and the Cleaning machine (Compressed Air Blasting) at USA and India, which no migration seeded, so Cleaning, a step of every additive route, had no machine. exceptions.1071_additive_catalog_machine_class.sql: Sets machine_class on the Additive Manufacturing process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings rows (migration 790) where it is NULL, from the classes migrations 793 and 1070 seeded, as migration 1064 did for Composites: a catalog row with no machine class cannot be active, so the additive calculators of migration 1072 could not be opened. Remove this entry when process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5).

exceptions.1076_assembly_catalog_machine_class.sql: Sets machine_class on the Assembly process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings rows (migrations 609, 790) where it is NULL, from the classes migrations 794 and 1075 seeded, as migrations 1064 and 1071 did: a catalog row with no machine class cannot be active, so the assembly calculators could not be opened. exceptions.1077_assembly_dfa_operation_times.sql: Stages the manual fastening times of the Mechanical Assembly operations (screw, nut, snap fit) as assembly_tblDfaOperationTimes beside the assembly reference data (2026-Assembly): Boothroyd and Dewhurst's published Design for Manual Assembly handling and insertion times, the eMithran baseline (user decision 2026-11-18). memory/Assembly names the operations but gives no time for them, so an assembly's screws could not be costed. exceptions.1079_assembly_molding_machines_india.sql: Adds the Assembly Molding machines at India rates (USA twins of migration 862 with the India export's overhead rates and the India labour of each process's wage grade, also in usd_lhr_total), so an insert-molded part can be priced in India. It writes inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1080_assembly_molding_press_columns.sql: Fills the insert molding presses' typed press columns (max_tonnage, shot_capacity_grams, press_cycle_time_s, mold heights, tie bars) from their own specs, as migration 633 did for the injection presses, links the Insert Injection Molding catalog row to the injection cycle-time calculator (migration 975) and links Assembly Molding to the Plastic & Rubber materials. exceptions.1085_assembly_plastic_molding_machines.s: Adds the Assembly Plastic Molding machines at India rates (USA twins of migration 862 with the India export's overhead rates and the India labour of each process's wage grade, also in usd_lhr_total), renames the USA 2900kN rotary stack press 1060g -> 1860g, and fills the multi-shot presses' typed press columns and specs (injection units, stations, rotating stack, tool index time) from the India export's columns, and the loaders' loading / max_payload specs. exceptions.1087_assembly_plastic_molding_catalog.sq: Links the Multi-Shot Molding catalog row to the injection cycle-time calculator (migration 975), activates it, and links Assembly Plastic Molding to the Plastic & Rubber materials. exceptions.1088_plastic_trim_pull_test_catalog_rows: Adds the Plastic Molding process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings rows for gate trimming, deflashing and the insert pull test (their own machine classes, bound to their calculators of migrations 1083, 1010 and 1084), so Apply saves them under their own operation instead of the deburring bench's Finishing / Deslag. exceptions.1089_bar_tube_machines_india_and_circula: Adds the Bar and Tube Fabrication machines at India rates (twins of the 277 USA machines of migration 862 with the India export's overhead rates and the India labour of each process's wage grade, also in usd_lhr_total) and the 11 Circular Saw machines at USA and India, which no migration seeded, so a bar or tube part priced in India had no machine on any step and nothing could cut on the Circular Saw the reference data routes round stock to. exceptions.1090_bar_tube_catalog_and_material_prope: Sets machine_class bar_tube_fab_circular_saw on the Circular Saw process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings rows (migration 862) where it is NULL, fills the shear, yield and tensile strength and the extrusion exit speeds (two new columns) of the 93 Bar and Tube raw_materials from memory/Bar and tube fab/Raw material/materials.csv where empty (migration 855 dropped them), and links the process group to its material group in process_material_groups, so the bar and tube calculators of migration 1091 can be opened and the material picker lists the process's own materials. exceptions.1092_bar_tube_material_specific_heat.sql: Fills specific_heat_rt_j_kg_k of the 93 Bar and Tube raw_materials from memory/Bar and tube fab/Raw material/materials.csv where empty (migration 855 dropped it, 1090 did not fill it), so the billet preheat of an extruded profile (calculator Bar and Tube - Billet preheat, migration 1091) can be computed. Remove this entry when raw_materials ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1093_multi_spindle_machine_limits.sql: Writes the 15 Simultaneous Turning machines' limits and slide layout (memory/Machining/machine/simultaneous_turning_usa.csv: bar capacity and part length into the typed max_diameter_mm and max_length_mm the machine selector reads, the slide configuration, back-work spindles and machine times into specs) on both locations' rows by name, so Multi-Spindle Machining can check a part's bar against each machine and lay out its stations. Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1094_multi_spindle_catalog_and_material_: Adds the Multi-Spindle Machining > Simultaneous Turning row to process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings (machine class simultaneous_turning) for the cycle calculator of migration 1095, and links the process group to Machining's material groups in process_material_groups, so the process group's catalog reaches its machining and the material picker lists its materials. Remove this entry when process_taxonomy, process_calculator_mappings and process_material_groups ship in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1096_machining_fractional_crews.sql: Restores the crew (mhr_records.operators) of the 16 Machining machines whose memory/machining/machine crew is a fraction: the 15 Simultaneous Turning machines (0.25 per multi-spindle, 0.5 per twin-spindle turning center) and the automated deburr cell (0.5), on both locations' rows by name. exceptions.1098_part_assembly_machines.sql: Writes the specs the Part Assembly calculators read onto its 20 welders (migration 864 matched the class names migration 827 had already renamed, so they had none), restores the robotic spot welders' 0.10 crew (inserted as 0), and adds the 25 machines' India twins from memory/Countries data, as migration 1075 did for Assembly: without them a welded part has no machine data to cost and none in India. exceptions.1099_part_assembly_catalog_machine_class: Sets machine_class on the Part Assembly process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings rows (migration 790) where it is NULL, from the classes migrations 795 and 827 gave its machines, as migration 1076 did for Assembly: a catalog row with no machine class cannot be active, so the Part Assembly calculators could not be opened. Remove this entry when process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1100_part_assembly_calculators.sql: Creates the Part Assembly calculators (MIG, spot and laser seam welding, bevel cutting, grinding, finish grinding, wire brushing) and links each Part Assembly catalog row to its calculator: without them a part whose Process is Part Assembly has no cost model. Remove this entry when calculators and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1101_powder_metal_machines.sql: Restores the crews memory/Powder metal/Machines gives the 16 Powder Metal machines (half an operator on nine presses, one and a half on the 36" belt furnace; stored as 1 and 2 when the column held whole numbers, so their labour was charged up to twice over) and adds their India twins from memory/Countries data (the export's overheads, labour at the India rate of the 4 - Metal wage grade), as migration 1098 did for Part Assembly: without them a powder metal part in India had no machines to cost. Only operators is written on the USA rows. Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1102_powder_metal_materials.sql: Fills density_kg_m3 and density of the 7 Powder Metal raw_materials from memory/Powder metal/Raw material/raw_materials.csv (the Green Density; migration 855 left both empty, so every material lookup outside the powder metal route reported the powder not found and priced it at 0) where empty, and links the process group to its material group in process_material_groups, so the material picker of a powder metal part lists the powders. Remove this entry when raw_materials and process_material_groups ship in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1103_rapid_prototyping_machines.sql: Renames the Rapid Prototyping machines' specs (migration 862) to the keys the additive engine reads for the same machines (printing layer speed, layer thickness and scanning width; stereolithography scanning and wiper speed), adds each laser's cost per hour from memory/Rapid prototyping/Lookup, stores the machines' flags as booleans, and adds the 25 machines' India twins from memory/Countries data: without them a Rapid Prototyping part has no machine data to cost and none in India. exceptions.1104_rapid_prototyping_material_group.sq: Links the Rapid Prototyping process group to its own material group in process_material_groups (migration 855's 50 materials): without it the material picker of a Rapid Prototyping part lists every material. exceptions.1105_rapid_prototyping_calculators.sql: Creates the Rapid Prototyping calculators (laser sintering, 3D printing, stereolithography, part curing, cleaning per hole and void, and their helpers) and links each Rapid Prototyping catalog row to its calculator: without them a part whose Process is Rapid Prototyping has no cost model. exceptions.1106_roto_blow_machines_india.sql: Adds the India twins of the 19 Roto & Blow Molding machines migration 862 seeded for the USA only to mhr_records: each USA row cloned at its India overhead rate (memory/Countries data/India_XML_Data_.csv, commodity Roto & Blow Molding) and the India labour rate of its process's wage grade. Rates are written only where none is set. Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1110_hydroforming_calculators.sql: Creates the Sheet Metal - Hydroforming calculators (the hydroform press cycle of the Deep Draw and Fluid Cell routes, the offline blanking stroke, and their helpers: tool cleaning, throw pad, hand adjusting, parts per tray, blanking force, blank, material, hydroform tool, tool life) and links the Hydroform and Offline Blank catalog rows to their calculators: without them a part whose Process is Sheet Metal - Hydroforming has no cost model and is priced as plain sheet metal. Remove this entry when calculators and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1112_roll_forming_machines.sql: Rates the 125 Sheet Metal Roll Forming line machines migration 862 seeded for the USA at the memory files' World Average rates with the Netherlands export's overheads (no export lists the USA; the user's decision, as 1109 for Hydroforming) and the USA labour of each wage grade (4 - Metal 43.21, 3 - Metal 36.30), only while a row still holds the seeded rates; adds the India twins of all 125 from memory/Countries data/India_XML_Data_.csv (labour 2.30 / 1.73); and links the process group to its own material group (migration 855's materials): without them a roll formed part has no rated line to price, none in India, and a material picker listing every material. Remove this entry when mhr_records and process_material_groups ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in them.
exceptions.1113_roll_forming_calculators.sql: Creates the Sheet Metal Roll Forming calculators (the coil line's Coil Material Stock, Uncoiler, Coil Flattener, Punch Press, Roll Forming Mill, integrated welding and Cut-Off Press, and their helpers: level passes, roll stations, line speed, coil change, die re-sharpening, strip, material, press force, roll tooling, press die) and links the ten Sheet Metal Roll Forming catalog rows to their calculators, activating them: without them a part whose Process is Sheet Metal Roll Forming has no cost model. Remove this entry when calculators and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1114_stock_machining_reference.sql: Stages the rest of Stock Machining's reference tables under 2026-Stock-Machining (the whole preferred stock sizes table, the parting ring widths, the plate part spacings, the validation display controls, and the group's processes and operations), adds its Material Stock machine (Default Material Stock, the stock as supplied at no rate) for USA and India, gives its Band Saw and Material Stock catalog rows their machine classes and adds its User-Defined Process row: without them the stock a machined part is cut from cannot be sized from the reference sizes or find its machines, so Stock Machining stays without a cost model. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data, mhr_records and process_taxonomy ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1115_stock_machining_mapping_classes.sql: Gives the two Stock Machining rows of process_calculator_mappings (Band Saw, Material Stock; migration 790) the machine classes their processes have in process_taxonomy (band_saw, stock_machining_material_stock; migration 1114): a mapping becomes active when a calculator is linked to it and it has a machine class, so without them migration 1116's calculators would leave both rows inactive. Remove this entry when process_calculator_mappings ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1116_stock_machining_calculators.sql: Creates the Stock Machining calculators (Material Stock, the stock as supplied; the stock's size by the allowance rule; the bar and plate bought per part; the Band Saw's cut, feed, load and unload; the scrap credit) and links the Band Saw and Material Stock catalog rows to their calculators, activating them: without them a part whose Process is Stock Machining has no cost model. Remove this entry when calculators and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1119_stock_machining_perimeter_cut.sql: Creates the Stock Machining - Perimeter Cut calculator (the cut round a plate part's outline through the plate's thickness, in passes by the slotting rule of Machining - Obround Slot Milling, each pass the outline at the cutter's feed rate), a helper no catalog operation maps to: without it the roughing technique Perimeter Milling with Drop-off, which the staged data names, cannot be timed and is listed as unavailable. It writes inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when calculators ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with this row in it.
exceptions.1120_operation_capability_obround_slot_m: Adds one row to the staged operation_capability_process table of machining_reference_data (migration 882): Obround Slot Milling is judged against the Milling capability, the project owner's decision of 2026-11-23. A milled keyway is costed as Obround Slot Milling and is now labelled by it, and without the link its required tolerances are not judged; an already staged table can only be completed in place. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the row in it.
exceptions.1123_raw_material_rupee_prices_in_usd.sq: Converts two raw_materials prices that were entered in local currency (304 at Rs 190, Generic Aluminum ANSI 6101 at Rs 296 and 18.22 yuan) to USD per kg, the unit of every other row, now that the costing reads the columns as USD. The cited values are kept, converted with the app's own INR rate. Remove this entry when raw_materials ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1128_machining_turning_follows_the_workb: Replaces the fields of the Rough Turning, Finish Turning and Stock Prep Lathe calculators so that a turning cut is timed as the Machining calculator workbook's Turning sheet times it (spindle speed from the diameter the cut starts at, the turned length plus a 10 mm approach per pass, passes = stock / depth of cut), the project owner's decision of 2026-11-23, and re-links the lathe catalog rows to them: the engine evaluates these stored formulas, so without the rows the quote keeps the earlier timing. Remove this entry when calculators and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1129_pcb_machines_india_and_classes.sql: Adds the India twins of the PCB fabrication machines migration 797 seeded for the USA only to mhr_records (each USA row cloned at its India overhead rate from memory/Countries data/India_XML_Data_.csv, commodity PCB, and the India labour rate of its process's wage grade), and gives the PCB rows of process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings (migration 790) the machine classes migration 797 gave each process. Without them a board priced in India has no machine and no PCB calculator can activate a mapping. The inserts are inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when mhr_records, process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1130_pcb_sourced_reference.sql: Stages three lookup tables of source version 2026-PCB in machining_reference_data: memory/PCBA/consumables.csv, process_times.csv and yield.csv, the researched and sourced values (each row with its source_url, source_date and source_note; user decision 2026-11-23) that memory/PCBA does not state and the PCB cost engine reads beside the stack-up tables of migration 823: consumables and tooling, plating and finish times, the working panel, fabrication yield by layer count. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with these tables in it.
exceptions.1132_pcb_calculators.sql: Creates the PCB calculators (one per fabrication process: surface preparation, photo resist, photolithography, DES, AOI, lay-up, lamination, registration and circuit drilling, laser vias, desmear and through-hole plating, developing, pattern plating and tin, SES, via plugging and its cure, solder mask coat, tack dry, film imaging, develop and cure, legend print and cure, HASL, ENIG, OSP, router, stamp, flying probe, bed of nails, AVI; and their helpers: board material, core price, drilling consumables, solder mask, plating metal, test fixture, fabrication yield) and links each PCB catalog row to its calculator, so a part whose Process is PCB is costed. It writes inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when calculators, calculator_fields and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1133_pcba_assembly_machines_and_referenc: Seeds the PCB assembly machines (the SMT line, through-hole soldering, in-circuit and flying probe testers, depanel routers; memory/PCBA/Assembly/smt_machines.csv, new listings only) into mhr_records for the USA and India at the rates the reference's own overhead rule gives their price, power and floor area; stages two lookup tables of source version 2026-PCB in machining_reference_data (memory/PCBA/Assembly/assembly_rates.csv and assembly_costs.csv, researched and sourced: user decision 2026-11-23); and adds the PCB catalog's assembly processes to process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings with their machine classes. Without them a board with components is priced as a bare board. The India rows are inserted inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when mhr_records, machining_reference_data, process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1134_pcba_assembly_calculators.sql: Creates the PCB assembly calculators (stencil print, solder paste inspection, pick and place, reflow, assembly AOI, THT insertion, wave, selective and hand soldering, in-circuit test, assembly flying probe, depanel router; and their helpers: SMT line changeover, SMT line balance, solder paste, ICT fixture) and links each PCB assembly catalog row of migration 1133 to its calculator, so a populated board is assembled in its quote. It writes inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when calculators, calculator_fields and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1136_machining_spindle_limits.sql: Writes each cutting machine's top spindle speed, and its driven-tool spindle speed where it has one (memory/machining/machine/*.csv: limits.spindleSpeedRpm, rates.liveToolingSpindleSpeedRpm), into specs on every location's mhr_records rows by machine class and name, for the 16 lathe, mill, mill-turn, router, drill and bore classes. A cutting calculator caps its spindle speed n = 1000 v / (pi D) at the machine's own limit (the machining workbook's rebuild, the project owner's decision of 2026-11-24) instead of a 10,000 rpm default. Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1137_machining_workbook_cutting_data.sql: Stages ten lookup tables in machining_reference_data from memory/machining/workbook/*.csv: the machining calculator workbook's cutting speeds and feeds (turning conditions, drilling and reaming data, HSS hole speeds, boring feed, milling conditions, the Uddeholm Corrax tables), its tool prices and lives, laser and plasma feed and kerf, the band saw rate, and the map from the engine's material classes to the workbook's material names. The workbook-form calculators read their speeds and feeds from these (the project owner's decision of 2026-11-24). Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with these tables in it.
exceptions.1138_machining_turning_family_workbook.s: Replaces the Rough Turning, Finish Turning, Stock Prep Lathe and Parting calculators and adds End Facing, Thread Turning and Knurling, so the turning family is timed as the machining calculator workbook times it (speeds and feeds from its Turning cutting conditions, whole passes, the approach allowance, the spindle capped at the machine's limit, whole seconds per cut; tool price over tool life as the line's tool cost), the project owner's decision of 2026-11-24, and links the lathe catalog rows to them: the engine evaluates these stored formulas, so without the rows the quote keeps the earlier timing. Remove this entry when calculators and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1139_machining_hole_making_workbook.sql: Replaces the Drilling, Drill Press, Reaming and Tapping calculators and adds Step Drilling, Internal Boring and Boring, so hole making is timed as the machining calculator workbook times it (speeds and feeds from its drilling, reaming, HSS hole-speed and boring tables by material and diameter band, the approach allowance and the reamer's point length, the spindle capped at the machine's limit, whole seconds per hole; tool price over tool life as the line's tool cost), with the workbook's Tapping sheet corrected to feed one thread pitch a turn, in and back out (the project owner's decision of 2026-11-24), and links the drilling, boring and tapping catalog rows to them: the engine evaluates these stored formulas, so without the rows the quote keeps the earlier timing. Remove this entry when calculators and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1140_machining_milling_named_ops_workboo: Replaces the Facing, Rough Milling and Slot Milling calculators and adds Plunge Milling, so the named milling operations are timed as the machining calculator workbook times them (its Face, End, Slot and Plunge Milling sheets: speeds and feeds from its milling conditions for the material, whole width and depth passes, the approach allowance, the spindle capped at the machine's limit, whole seconds per cut; the end mill's price over its life as the line's tool cost), with the sheets' corrections stated in each description (whole passes, a stepover of at least half the cutter, plunges half a cutter apart along the slot), the project owner's decision of 2026-11-24. They replace a fixed 45 s of facing, 20 s a slot and a pocket's or flat's volume at the removal rate. It links the lathe and mill catalog rows to them: the engine evaluates these stored formulas, so without the rows the quote keeps the earlier timing. Remove this entry when calculators and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1141_machining_rapid_traverse_rates.sql: Writes each cutting machine's rapid traverse rate (memory/machining/machine/*.csv: rates.rapidTraverseRateMmPerMin and its spellings) into specs on every location's mhr_records rows by machine class and name, for the 198 machines in 16 classes migration 1136 gave a spindle limit. The milling line's rapid moves between features are at it, in place of a flat 15 % allowance (the project owner's decision of 2026-11-24). Remove this entry when mhr_records ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1142_machining_milling_rapids_tool_chang: Replaces the Machining - Milling station calculator, so a mill's line adds a tool change for each cutter its operations use (an editable 5 s: no mill record states one) and a rapid move to each feature they cut (the machining variables' rapidTransferDistanceFactor x the part's box length, at the machine's rapid traverse rate of migration 1141), in place of a flat 15 % allowance on the cutting time (the project owner's decision of 2026-11-24), and links the lathe and mill catalog rows to it: the engine evaluates this stored formula, so without the rows the quote keeps the earlier timing. Remove this entry when calculators and process_calculator_mappings ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1143_stock_machining_india_rules.sql: Stages India's stock rules beside memory/Stock Maching's USA rows (source version 2026-Stock-Machining, source_region India), from the machining calculator workbook's Material calc sheets: a 3000 mm bar, a 5 mm bar end, a 2 mm cut between parts, a 3000 x 1000 mm plate, the scrap credited at 95 % recovery (the project owner's decision of 2026-11-24). The stock reader takes a location's own row where it has one, else the reference's. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1144_stock_machining_scrap_recovery.sql: Replaces the Stock Machining - Scrap Credit calculator with its version 2, which sells only the recovered share of the scrap (the location's scrapRecoveryPercent of migration 1143, else all of it): the engine evaluates this stored formula, so without it the credit keeps the whole scrap weight. Remove this entry when calculators ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with this row in it.
